language.title: Which language?
language.description: The language you want to practice, e.g. Spanish, Japanese, French.

tools.name: practice_state
tools.description: Read the practice state: the scene in play (the part you play, the setting, the student's goal), the student's level and streak, and corrections due for review.

tools.name: reply
tools.description: Answer the student during a scene. `say` is your next line in the language being practiced, in character and at their level (one or two short sentences). `errors` lists up to three mistakes in the student's last message as { wrong, right, note? }, quoting their exact words in `wrong`; leave it empty when they made none. Set `done` only after the student has reached the scene's goal, never on your opening line.

say.description: Your next line, in the language being practiced (max 240 characters).

errors.description: Mistakes in the student's last message, at most three; an empty list when there were none.

note.description: A very short reason, in English.

done.description: True when the student reached the scene's goal.

tools.name: begin_scene
tools.description: Start a role-play scene the student asked for, by scenario id or title (coffee, market, neighbor, directions, pharmacy, luggage, restaurant, hotel, doctor, return). Then open it with reply.

tools.name: advance_level
tools.description: Advance the student to the next level when the current scenes feel comfortable.

tools.name: start_scene
tools.description: Start a scene from the dashboard.

reaction.prompt: The student started the scene "{{output.scene.title}}". You play the {{output.scene.youPlay}}. Setting: {{output.scene.setting}} The student's goal: {{output.scene.studentGoal}} Open the scene with one short line in {{language}}, in character and at level {{output.level}}, through reply with no errors. The scene has only begun: do not set done.

tools.name: review_card
tools.description: Grade a review card from the dashboard.

tools.name: end_scene
tools.description: End the scene in play from the dashboard.
